#### Shandong Haili Chemical Industry Co., Ltd.: Driving High-Quality Growth Through Innovation and
#### Green Manufacturing

As the global chemical industry accelerates toward industrial upgrading, sustainable development,
and low-carbon transformation, a new generation of leading chemical manufacturers is emerging
through advanced production capabilities, continuous technological innovation, and expanding
international presence. Shandong Haili Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. is one of these outstanding
enterprises. Rooted in Shandong Province for more than two decades, the company has evolved from a
producer of basic chemical materials into a comprehensive manufacturer of high-value fine chemicals,
earning its place among China's leading chemical enterprises.Established in 2003, Shandong Haili
Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. is located in the Dacheng Industrial Zone of Huantai Economic
Development Zone, Zibo City, Shandong Province—one of China's most important chemical industry
clusters. Benefiting from excellent transportation infrastructure, including convenient access to
the Jiqing and Binbo Expressways, the company enjoys efficient logistics for both raw material
procurement and product distribution.Its proximity to the Qilu Chemical Industrial Park provides a
well-developed petrochemical supply chain and abundant raw material resources, creating ideal
conditions for large-scale production and industrial integration.After more than 20 years of steady
development, Haili Chemical has grown into a major chemical enterprise with a registered capital of
RMB 300 million, a production area exceeding 1.79 million square meters, and a workforce of more
than 3,000 employees. Supported by mature production management systems, strict quality control, and
an experienced technical team, the company has established standardized, large-scale, and efficient
operations while earning numerous industry recognitions as a key player in Shandong's fine chemical
sector.With years of expertise in both basic and fine chemicals, Haili Chemical has developed a
diversified product portfolio covering a wide range of industrial applications. Its major products
include:Epichlorohydrin (ECH)Adipic AcidCaprolactamCyclohexanoneChlor-Alkali ProductsLiquid
ChlorineHydrogen PeroxideThese products are widely used in industries such as advanced materials,
textiles, pharmaceuticals, plastics and rubber, environmental protection, coatings, and precision
manufacturing.Leveraging stringent quality management and large-scale production capacity, several
of the company's flagship products have become industry leaders. Its epichlorohydrin production
capacity ranks among the largest single-site capacities in Asia, while its adipic acid production
capacity ranks among the leading producers in China. As one of the few domestic manufacturers
capable of large-scale production across multiple core chemical products, Haili Chemical delivers
reliable quality, stable supply, and competitive pricing.Today, the company's products are sold
throughout China and exported to numerous overseas markets, including Pakistan, Mexico, Turkey, and
many other countries and regions. Serving hundreds of international customers, Haili Chemical has
established a mature global sales network supported by both domestic and international
markets.Technological innovation has always been the driving force behind Haili Chemical's long-term
development. Rather than relying on traditional extensive manufacturing models, the company
continuously invests in research and development to optimize production technologies, improve energy
efficiency, and develop higher-value chemical products.To date, Haili Chemical has obtained more
than 80 patents, covering process optimization, environmental protection equipment, purification
technologies, energy-saving solutions, and production safety systems. These innovations have
significantly improved production efficiency, reduced energy consumption, enhanced product purity,
and strengthened overall competitiveness.The company has also introduced advanced production
equipment and intelligent manufacturing systems to promote digitalized management and automated
production. From raw material processing and manufacturing to quality inspection, warehousing, and
logistics, every stage is managed through refined operational control, ensuring consistent product
quality and reliable supply for customers worldwide.Sustainable development has become a fundamental
strategy for Haili Chemical. Throughout its development, the company has consistently adhered to the
principles of safety, environmental responsibility, and regulatory compliance, integrating these
values into every aspect of production and management.In terms of safety, Haili Chemical has
established a comprehensive safety management system featuring real-time monitoring, standardized
operating procedures, regular employee training, hazard inspections, and emergency response drills.
By strictly implementing China's chemical industry safety standards, the company continuously
strengthens its production safety capabilities.Regarding environmental protection, Haili Chemical
actively supports China's carbon reduction initiatives by investing in energy-saving upgrades,
wastewater and waste gas treatment facilities, solid waste recycling, and cleaner production
technologies. Continuous process optimization has effectively reduced emissions, improved resource
utilization, and minimized environmental impact, enabling the company to achieve balanced economic,
environmental, and social benefits.From its establishment in 2003 to becoming a leading enterprise
in China's fine chemical industry, Haili Chemical's growth reflects the successful transformation of
China's modern chemical manufacturing sector. As global demand continues to shift toward
premium-quality, environmentally friendly, and high-performance chemical materials, the company
remains committed to embracing new opportunities in industrial upgrading.Looking forward, Haili
Chemical will continue focusing on its core chemical business while strengthening technological
innovation, optimizing its product portfolio, extending its industrial value chain, and expanding
its presence in both domestic and international markets. The company will further invest in advanced
fine chemical materials, intelligent manufacturing, and sustainable production technologies to
create greater value for customers worldwide.By adhering to responsible management, continuous
innovation, and green manufacturing principles, Shandong Haili Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. is
committed to contributing to the high-quality development of China's fine chemical industry and
supporting the sustainable growth of global manufacturing.With more than two decades of dedication,
innovation, and steady progress, Haili Chemical will continue building a stronger future—advancing
the chemical industry through technology, sustainability, and excellence. Mobile:

About Us

**COMPANY PROFILE**

Shandong Tianli Energy Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Tianli), established in 1994, is a
state-level high-tech enterprise held by Shandong Scitech Innovation Group Co., Ltd. Tianli takes
drying, calcination, evaporation high-end equipment and related green and low-carbon projects as the
core, develops chemical and new material frontier projects, and is a supplier of core equipment and
overall engineering solutions for energy and materials. The business scope includes engineering
design, project operation management, core equipment manufacturing, equipment integration and EPC
contracting, mainly serving the petrochemical, new energy, new materials, biochemical, energy saving
and environmental protection industries. Tianli is the President of China General Machinery
Association Drying Branch and Leader of Drying Professional Group of CIESC, and is the leader of
China’s drying industry.

About Us

**COMPANY PROFILE**

Shandong Tianli Energy Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Tianli), established in 1994, is a
state-level high-tech enterprise held by Shandong Scitech Innovation Group Co., Ltd. Tianli takes
drying, calcination, evaporation high-end equipment and related green and low-carbon projects as the
core, develops chemical and new material frontier projects, and is a supplier of core equipment and
overall engineering solutions for energy and materials. The business scope includes engineering
design, project operation management, core equipment manufacturing, equipment integration and EPC
contracting, mainly serving the petrochemical, new energy, new materials, biochemical, energy saving
and environmental protection industries. Tianli is the President of China General Machinery
Association Drying Branch and Leader of Drying Professional Group of CIESC, and is the leader of
China’s drying industry.

## Who We Are

#### Our Mission

At 2B Chemical, our mission is to be the premier provider of chemical solutions, driving innovation
and progress across diverse industries. We are committed to delivering high-quality chemicals to the
pharmaceutical, painting, cosmetics, detergents, and beyond. Our focus is on fostering partnerships,
ensuring reliability, and exceeding customer expectations. Through strategic distribution and
unwavering dedication to quality, safety, and sustainability, we aim to empower our clients to
thrive and make a positive impact on the world. At 2B chemical, we don't just distribute chemicals;
we catalyze success for our partners in every formula.We believe that our success is dependent on
the success of our clients, and we work tirelessly to help them achieve their goals.

#### Our Expertise

At 2B Chemical, our unwavering commitment to excellence is underscored by our extensive expertise in
chemical distribution. As a leading force in the industry, we specialize in delivering top-tier
chemical solutions to a diverse array of sectors, including pharmaceuticals, paints, cosmetics,
detergents, and beyond. With a keen understanding of the unique requirements of each industry, our
team of seasoned professionals ensures that our clients receive unparalleled service and tailored
solutions. Whether it's sourcing high-quality raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations,
providing specialized pigments for vibrant paints, or delivering premium ingredients for cosmetics
and detergents, we take pride in being the trusted partner that propels your business forward.
Choose 2B Chemical for precision, reliability, and a steadfast commitment to meeting your chemical
needs across various industries.

#### Our Values

At 2B Chemical, integrity and innovation are the cornerstones of our values. We prioritize safety,
quality, and sustainability, ensuring the seamless supply of premium chemicals to pharmaceutical,
painting, cosmetics, detergents, and various industries. Committed to excellence, we foster
collaborative partnerships, driving progress and meeting diverse needs with reliability and
responsibility.

[Ordinary Fluid Bed Dryer][256]
Fluid bed dryer is a dryer with high thermal efficiency, suitable for low temperature drying of heat
sensitive material.
/
[Fluid Bed Dryer With Built-In Heat Exchanger][257]
Internal heated fluid bed dryer is a new drying technology developed on the basis of traditional
fluid bed dryer by indirect heating drying.
/
[Calcination Kiln][258]
The rotary calciner is modified on the basis of conventional rotary cylinder dryer by changing the
form of its heat source. An arched heating device (stacked kiln body) is added outside the middle
section of the cylinder of the traditional rotary cylinder dryer, and the cylinder is heated by a
plurality of burners distributed around the circumference of the kiln by burning a heat source such
as natural gas. The treated material is discharged from the lower end by the inclination of the
cylinder.
/
[Ordinary Rotary Dryer][259]
Rotary dryer is a kind of drying equipment for processing large quantities of materials. It has
characteristics of reliable operation, large operation flexibility, strong adaptability, large
processing capacity, strong adaptability of materials, drying of various materials. It is widely
used in building materials, metallurgy, chemical, cement industry to dry slag limestone, coal
powder, slag, clay and other materials.
/
[Vibrating Fluid Bed Dryer][260]
In modern industrial production, drying is an indispensable key link in many industries, from
chemical, food, medicine to agriculture, etc., there are extremely high requirements for the
efficiency, quality and energy consumption of material drying. As a high-efficiency and
energy-saving drying equipment, vibrating fluid bed dryer dryer occupies an important position in
the field of industrial drying with its unique working principle and significant performance
advantages.
/
[Paddle Dryer][261]
Paddle dryer is an indirect conduction heating type drying device, which is suitable for processing
materials with good thermal stability such as paste, powder and granular. After special
configuration, it can be used for processing heat sensitive materials, materials that need recover
solvents during drying process and materials that need to be dried under rough vacuum. At the same
time, paddle dryer can also be used for cooling of powder and granular materials and cooling and
crystallization of some special materials by injecting cooling medium. It also can inject heating
medium for heating materials and reactor to be heated.
/

[Ordinary Fluid Bed Dryer][256]
Fluid bed dryer is a dryer with high thermal efficiency, suitable for low temperature drying of heat
sensitive material.
/
[Fluid Bed Dryer With Built-In Heat Exchanger][257]
Internal heated fluid bed dryer is a new drying technology developed on the basis of traditional
fluid bed dryer by indirect heating drying.
/
[Calcination Kiln][258]
The rotary calciner is modified on the basis of conventional rotary cylinder dryer by changing the
form of its heat source. An arched heating device (stacked kiln body) is added outside the middle
section of the cylinder of the traditional rotary cylinder dryer, and the cylinder is heated by a
plurality of burners distributed around the circumference of the kiln by burning a heat source such
as natural gas. The treated material is discharged from the lower end by the inclination of the
cylinder.
/
[Ordinary Rotary Dryer][259]
Rotary dryer is a kind of drying equipment for processing large quantities of materials. It has
characteristics of reliable operation, large operation flexibility, strong adaptability, large
processing capacity, strong adaptability of materials, drying of various materials. It is widely
used in building materials, metallurgy, chemical, cement industry to dry slag limestone, coal
powder, slag, clay and other materials.
/
[Vibrating Fluid Bed Dryer][260]
In modern industrial production, drying is an indispensable key link in many industries, from
chemical, food, medicine to agriculture, etc., there are extremely high requirements for the
efficiency, quality and energy consumption of material drying. As a high-efficiency and
energy-saving drying equipment, vibrating fluid bed dryer dryer occupies an important position in
the field of industrial drying with its unique working principle and significant performance
advantages.
/
[Paddle Dryer][261]
Paddle dryer is an indirect conduction heating type drying device, which is suitable for processing
materials with good thermal stability such as paste, powder and granular. After special
configuration, it can be used for processing heat sensitive materials, materials that need recover
solvents during drying process and materials that need to be dried under rough vacuum. At the same
time, paddle dryer can also be used for cooling of powder and granular materials and cooling and
crystallization of some special materials by injecting cooling medium. It also can inject heating
medium for heating materials and reactor to be heated.
/

complex business data and actionable insights. When implemented effectively, it enables
organizations to consolidate data from multiple systems, standardize reporting, and deliver
real-time visibility into key performance indicators. Organizations often integrate data from ERP
systems, CRM platforms, finance tools, and operational databases into a centralized analytics
environment. With proper configuration, Power BI becomes a single interface where leadership teams
can track performance metrics, monitor operational trends, and evaluate strategic initiatives.

ongoing optimization, areas where consulting expertise becomes essential. What Happens During a

business objectives and existing data infrastructure. Consultants work closely with business
stakeholders to identify key performance indicators, reporting requirements, and data sources. This

simply replicating existing reports. During this stage, consulting teams also evaluate data quality,

# Revolutionizing Adipic Acid Production

#### Join us in creating a sustainable future for the apparel, automotive, and electronics
#### industries.

[ Learn More ][12]

### We are transforming the way adipic acid is made.

[ Contact us to learn more. ][13]

Our innovative bio-derived process not only makes adipic acid cleaner and cheaper but also
significantly reduces carbon emissions.

#### Our Solution for Evolving Adipic Acid Production.

UP Biochemicals offers a new way to produce adipic acid that is both environmentally friendly and
cost-effective. Our bio-derived process significantly reduces carbon emissions while maintaining the
high quality needed for nylon production.

#### Cleaner Production

UP Biochemicals makes adipic acid cleaner by utilizing a bio-derived process, as opposed to
traditional methods reliant on fossil fuels. This innovative approach significantly reduces carbon
emissions by 90%, minimizing the environmental impact associated with adipic acid production.

#### High-Quality Adipic Acid

UP’s proprietary catalyst technology precisely controls heat and mass transfer during the conversion
process. This advanced approach enhances reaction efficiency and purity, resulting in adipic acid
that meets the rigorous standards required for applications in textiles, automotive, and
electronics.

#### Affordable Nylon Production

Our adipic acid is more cost-effective than other green nylon alternatives due to its innovative
bio-derived process, significantly reducing production costs. Unlike fermentation-based methods,
which are often inefficient and expensive, UP Biochemicals’ proprietary catalyst technology ensures
high yields and purity with lower operational and separation costs.

[Columbus, OH Skyline]

Our first skid reactor plant will be located in Columbus, Ohio.

## Scaling Up Production

UP Biochemicals is committed to building a resilient and sustainable future for nylon production.
That’s why we are proud to utilize a domestic supply chain, ensuring ethical sourcing and supporting
American jobs. As we scale up manufacturing to meet the growing demand for our eco-friendly adipic
acid, we remain dedicated to minimizing our environmental footprint and providing our customers with
a reliable source of high-quality, domestically produced materials.

## Why Choose UP Biochemicals?

We redefine adipic acid production standards with our commitment to sustainability and innovation.

[Sustainability]

#### Sustainable Practices

Our technology reduces carbon emissions by over 90%, setting new environmental benchmarks.

[Cost-Effective]

#### Cost-Effective Solutions

We provide affordable, high-quality adipic acid to support diverse industries sustainably.

At UP Biochemicals, our mission is to revolutionize the production of adipic acid, making it
cleaner, more affordable, and environmentally friendly. We are committed to creating a green supply
chain that positively impacts the industries we serve.

сутки, **23 000 тонн сырья /год**.

2,2 тонн куриного жира/сутки;
Линия по приёму боенских отходов свинины 34,4 тонн/сутки, производство 6,7 тонн свиной муки/сутки и
4 тонны свиного жира/сутки;
